summary: The pipeline reads the images of a Jira ticket: screenshots embedded in the description or attached are read once by the ticket analyst through the Jira MCP server's image tool (jira_get_issue_images on mcp-atlassian), what each shows is recorded in requirements.json and used as part of the ticket, with requirements and criteria traced to the image; the refiner and planner work from that description without opening the images again. No approval or setting: without images nothing changes, and images that cannot be read are reported in the intake, the delivery report and the pull request. delivery-doctor reports whether the server has an image tool and how to enable it.
